message.content:
**Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College by royal charter of King George II of Great Britain, making it the fifth-oldest institution of higher education in the United States. The university moved to its current Morningside Heights campus in Manhattan in 1897.

Key facts:

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City, NY |
| **Founded** | 1754 (as King's College) |
| **Type** | Private research university |
| **Ivy League member** | Yes |
| **Campus** | Urban, 36 acres |
| **Student body** | ~30,000 (undergraduate, graduate, professional) |
| **Notable schools** | Columbia College (undergraduate), Columbia Law School, Columbia Business School, Columbia School of Engineering & Applied Science, Columbia School of Journalism, Columbia School of International and Public Affairs, etc. |
| **Endowment** | Over $10 billion (as of 2023) |
| **Mascot** | Lion (officially “Columbia Lion”) |
| **Colors** | Columbia Blue & White |
| **Athletics** | NCAA Division I, Big East Conference (men’s basketball, women’s basketball, etc.) |
| **Alumni** | 100+ Nobel laureates, 30 U.S. Presidents (including Barack Obama), 20 U.S. Supreme Court Justices, 200+ Pulitzer Prize winners, etc. |

Columbia is renowned for its rigorous academic programs, distinguished faculty, and contributions to research across disciplines such as physics, economics, literature, journalism, and public policy. Its flagship library, the **New York Public Library**, is one of the largest libraries in the world. The university also hosts the **Columbia University Medical Center** and the **Columbia University School of Nursing**.

If you need more specific details—such as admission statistics, tuition costs, or program rankings—just let me know!
